newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tobishima Corp shares hit year's low.
newsitem.headline: Tobishima Corp shares hit year's low.

text.p: Shares in Tobishima Corp, a construction company, hit their lowest level so far this year on Wednesday afternoon, brokers said.
As of 0510 GMT, the shares were down 17 yen at 373 yen. The previous low for the year was 380 yen, set on October 31.
"Performance-wise the company is weak, and with the overall market mood subdued as it is today, issues such as Tobishima Corp fall prey to selling," a second-tier brokerage broker said.

Tobishima said last month that it had drawn up a new restructuring plan to try to solve its financial difficulties. Under the plan, Tobishima was to ask its creditors, including Fuji Bank Ltd, to reduce their claims against Tobishima for the debts owed by its group companies from about 740 billion yen to 100 billion yen.
